title: Protect
description: Default settings for passcode-protected pages. Individual pages can override these in their Page Data JSON.

passcode.label: Default Passcode
passcode.help: Passcode visitors enter to unlock protected pages. Digits give visitors a number pad on phones; letters work too. Nothing is in effect until you save one here. Individual pages can override it in their Page Data. A page with Protect attached but no passcode is operators-only — logged-in admins can preview it, the public cannot.

promptTitle.label: Default Prompt Title
promptTitle.help: Heading shown on the passcode form. Pages can override this in their Page Data.

cookieHours.label: Remember For (hours)
cookieHours.help: How long a visitor stays unlocked after entering the passcode, in hours (168 = 7 days). Set to 0 for a session cookie that clears when the browser closes.

globalScope.label: Site-wide passcode
globalScope.help: Lock the whole site behind one shared passcode instead of locking each page separately. When on, every protected page uses the Default Passcode and a single unlock cookie — enter the code once and the whole site unlocks. Per-page passcodes and protectScope groups are ignored while this is on.

headerHtml.label: HTML Above the Form
headerHtml.help: Shown above the passcode form, inside the box: a logo, a welcome line, a contact link. Added as written, so it can hold <style> too. Applies to every protected page.

footerHtml.label: HTML at the Bottom of the Page
footerHtml.help: Shown at the bottom of the passcode page, below the box: a copyright line, links, a script. Added as written. Applies to every protected page.
